name: physmem-metropolis-return
purpose: iter-465 physmem lane: the Warworld -> Metropolis return on the NATURAL game (no mods, port features off). Title -> START -> the game's own LOAD A GAME? popup -> A = START NEW GAME -> main_hud -> the level-skip dev tool (plan data/devtools/plans/metropolis_return_from_new_game.txt) passes MSTobj01..03 (the MSTobj03 save prompt answered Continue Without Saving by the plan), WARobj01, WARobj02 -> the game returns to Metropolis and reloads it (the 224 MB world pool, 0xDFF0000) -> CinematicLuthorSteals is won there -> hold 120 s of Metropolis gameplay for frames. Before the fix the return died at [PHYS_CAP] guestPhysAlloc(0xDFF0000) -> [ICALL_FAIL] 8260527C. Dev-tool assisted (the plan drives the game's own objectives): tag results 'dev-tool assisted', still the natural code path. Gates: -Gates "SR_MODS=0,SR_DEVTOOLS=levelskip,SR_DEVTOOLS_CMDS=<abs plan>,SR_DEVTOOLS_OUT=<dir>,SR_INSTANCE_ID=physmem,SDL_AUDIODRIVER=disk". -TimeoutSeconds 1500.
